## Checklist

- [ ] I have read "What you give by contributing" in CONTRIBUTING.md and agree to it, including that the author may relicense my contribution
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Works on both Windows and Linux (no hard-coded path separators or OS-only APIs)
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour or the `.chd` format changed (`docs/file-format.md`)
- [ ] I understand and have tested the code I am submitting, including any written with an AI assistant
